```swift title="Swift"

let _request = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"temperature\":0}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chat(request: _request)
```
